title: Email & CRM Specialist
description:
Email & CRM Specialist

Salary: 38,000 - 45,000
Location: Coventry - 4 days office, 1 day from home

The Opportunity

We're looking for a commercially driven Email & CRM Specialist to join a growing international ecommerce business, taking ownership of email marketing and CRM across its UK and US markets.
This is an opportunity for someone who knows how to make CRM deliver commercially. We're looking beyond simply building and sending campaigns. We want someone who understands customer behaviour, knows how to use data to identify opportunities and has the technical expertise to turn those insights into increased revenue.
You'll play a key role in improving CRM performance, developing automated customer journeys and creating a testing strategy that drives measurable commercial improvements.

What you'll be doing
- Take ownership of email marketing and CRM performance across UK and US markets.
- Develop, manage and optimise automated Klaviyo Flows, particularly behavioural and product-led journeys.
- Build intelligent customer journeys that respond to browsing behaviour, product interest and purchasing activity.
- Drive commercial performance through improved conversion, revenue per recipient and customer retention.
- Develop and implement a structured A/B testing strategy across campaigns, content, segmentation and automated journeys.
- Analyse campaign and Flow performance, identifying gaps and opportunities to improve results.
- Produce meaningful performance reports, translating data into actionable commercial recommendations.
- Work closely with Ecommerce, Trading and Creative teams to align CRM activity with product launches, promotions and trading priorities.
- Continuously challenge existing processes and identify new ways to improve customer engagement and revenue.

What we're looking for
- At least 3 years' experience in ecommerce email marketing or CRM.
- Strong hands-on experience with Klaviyo, including campaign management, automation, segmentation and reporting.
- Proven experience building and optimising automated customer journeys and behavioural Flows.
- Strong analytical ability, with the confidence to interpret data, identify trends and make commercially driven decisions.
- Experience developing and implementing A/B testing strategies.
- A strong understanding of ecommerce customer journeys, conversion and retention.
- Someone who can identify when something isn't working and confidently recommend how to fix it.
- Commercially minded, proactive and comfortable taking ownership.

Desirable:
- Experience with Shopify, GA4, Yotpo and SMS marketing.
- Experience working within a product-led ecommerce business.

What makes this opportunity different?

You'll have genuine ownership of a key commercial channel within an ambitious, growing ecommerce business.
This isn't a role for someone who simply wants to send more emails. It's for someone who wants to understand the numbers, challenge performance, experiment with new approaches and make a tangible difference to revenue.
If you're analytical, commercially curious and passionate about making CRM work harder, we'd love to hear from you.

At Gleeson Recruitment Group, we embrace inclusivity and welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We are proud to be a disability confident employer.
By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Gleeson Recruitment Limited. Our Privacy Policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.

title: Marketing Assistant
company: Morris Clarke Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Experienced Marketing Assistant required to work for a prestigious Client based in Rugby.

Main Purpose of Job

To support the marketing strategy providing marketing support services in respect of the Company s prospects and customers.

Main Activities

1. Assist in building and maintaining a prospecting database and a customer database.

2. Maintain records relating to prospects and customers.

3. Maintain and foster good relations with prospects and customers through multi-marketing channels including but not exclusively; telephone, social media, email, e-shot and mail.

4. Gain valuable market intelligence to support Direct Marketing Unit team.

5. Support Managers and Sales Executives in administration duties as part of the Company s marketing strategy.

6. Provide information and feedback on marketing activities undertaken informing the direction of future campaign activity.

7. Organise, contribute towards the generation of and send social media post, communications and e-shots.

8. Carry out effective market research.

9. To adhere to all policies, procedures and codes of conduct as issued by the Company.

10. To be responsible for generating leads amongst prospects for Sales Executives aligned to Key Performance Indicators.

11. To support the organisation of marketing strategies to ensure business growth in line with the company objectives.

12. To support the Sales Executives in building long term relationships and trust amongst all of the company s customers.

Main Outcomes

1. To ensure the Company Prospect and Customer database is accurate and up to date.

2. Maintain and improve good customer relations.

3. Produce accurate and timely reports on marketing activities.

4. Complete accurate and timely marketing to a schedule of activities.

Ideal candiate will have experience of working in a busy Marketing Team, be computer literate and familiar with social media, have an excellent telephone manner and be happy to call customers in order to look after existing customers and gain new ones.

You will have accurate keyboard skills, be an active team player and be able to work on own initiative.

Hours of work ar Mon to Thurs 9am to 5pm

Fri 9am to 430pm

£7 hours per week

title: Office Administrator with Communications and Stewardship
company: Friends of the Holy Land - Agency - Permanent
description:
Do you have a way with words and an eye for a good story? We're looking for someone who can help people across the UK get to know the Christian communities we support in Palestine, Jordan and Israel and inspire more people to get involved.

You will work alongside our Operations Manager and the small office team to keep our charity running smoothly. You will also work with our Head of Communications, helping turn news from Bethlehem into stories for our website, put together supporter emails and look after our social media channels. You will get to know our supporters by phone, whether you're thanking a parish for its generosity or talking with someone considering a gift in their Will.

After you've been with us for 6 months we'll arrange a visit to the Holy Land so you can see the work first-hand.

You will need to be comfortable working in a faith-based organisation, making calls and talking to supporters and clergy across the UK and with our partners in the Holy Land.

If this sounds like something you'd enjoy and thrive at, please click on 'Apply Now' to download the full job specification and description.

title: Senior Marketing Executive
description:
Senior Marketing Executive

IT Networking & Security

Ideal Candidate Location - 1 hour of Coventry - Hybrid Working

Birmingham, Coventry, Northampton, Leicester, Rugby, Stratford, Warwick

Up to 48,000 Basic Salary + Bonus + Other benefits
- Are you a full mix B2 B marketing professional with experience working in a technical field?
- Do you have hands on experience in campaign management, content production, website maintenance & development, AI leveraged marketing operations?
- Are you keen to work for a fantastic company that is going through a period of renewal and expansion?
- Do you enjoy lead generation marketing and being rewarded for the ROI you help generate?

If you can answer yes to the above, this is a role for you!
Our client is looking for a driven Senior Marketing Executive who wants to get hands-on and really get stuck into this brilliant company's digital revamp.
Your Role as a Senior Marketing Executive:
- A hands-on role in a small marketing team, where most of the marketing output is produced in-house rather than via agency.
- Responsible for producing content and materials: web content, sales and customer collateral, case studies, web news stories, customer newsletters, factsheets and product release notes for direct and channel sales.
- Responsible for keeping product manuals, FAQs and other customer-facing technical content current and fit for purpose.
- Responsible for managing and extending integrated direct marketing campaigns: building contact lists, defining message sets, producing and automating campaign messages and workflows, and analysing performance. You will be accountable for the quantity and quality of leads generated.
- Responsible for the ongoing maintenance and development of the company's websites and microsites, including content publishing via WordPress and AI-supported HTML/CSS/JS, ongoing design improvement, SEO, PPC optimisation and LLM citation strategy. Web leads are the key route to the company's growth objectives.
- Responsible for building and maintaining a library of AI tools and workflows that multiply the team's output, such as writing and design engines, research tools, campaign generators and performance analysis. This is expected to be a significant differentiator in the role.
- Monitoring, analysing and reporting on campaign, website and content performance, using the data to improve lead generation, conversion rates, content effectiveness and sales support.
- Contributing to social media campaigns and to the overall direction of the web presence, with scope to take on more of this responsibility over time.
- Contributing to product strategy and product management, including analysis of market segments, geographies, pricing, channels and technologies, and developing tactical plans to position the products.
- On a more occasional basis: major content projects for new products and market initiatives, advanced animated sales presentations and webinar material, and material supporting partner marketing, PR, lobbying, advocacy and events.
- Working as part of the company's senior team. In the short term, you are likely to become either the strong number two to the marketing lead or the lead yourself.

Ideal Background for the Senior Marketing Executive:
- 3 years+ B2 B marketing experience with technical products and or services. Ideally in the IT / Technology market.
- Demonstrable hands-on use of AI in marketing; not occasional drafting, but specific examples of tools or workflows you have built and what they changed.
- A fluent copywriter with a solid portfolio, able to quickly absorb a technical proposition and turn it into clear, impactful messaging.
- Real expertise in one or more of copywriting, graphic design and digital marketing, with solid skills across the wider marketing mix.
- A proven ability to contribute to marketing strategy, with a track record of measurable campaign success.
- A rigorous, structured and data-driven approach to complex problems, including drawing well-judged conclusions from market assessments. This is likely, but not necessarily, backed by a strong degree.
- Highly organised and self-sufficient, bringing your own process and discipline, with a track record of delivering on commitments.
- A direct, confident communicator, written and verbal, who says what they think, backs it up and can deliver uncomfortable information clearly.
- A strong team player with the drive, energy and tenacity to thrive in an entrepreneurial SME rather than a large corporate environment.
- Right to work in the UK without sponsorship.

The Company recruiting for the Senior Marketing Executive:
- A UK-headquartered technology company developing specialist IT products for niche technical markets.
- Established for over 20 years, with customers in over 150 countries; more than 90% of sales are outside Europe, with the USA a key market.
- Their flagship product is the world leader in its niche, with significant growth opportunities in education and other high-value sectors worldwide.
- Run as a true marketing-led business, with a CEO who has vast experience in B2 B strategic marketing.
- Going through an exciting period of renewal and expansion, including new ventures in edtech and AI-driven business automation.
- A proven track record of developing people quickly and rewarding outstanding performance.

The Package for the Senior Marketing Executive:
- Up to 48,000 Basic Salary
- Half-Yearly Performance Bonus
- Hybrid Working
- Pension Scheme
- Clear Career Progression into Marketing Leadership
- Additional Company Benefits

Please apply for this job online if you are interested and feel you fit the above criteria.
John Ahearne is the main point of contact for the role.
